violated_contract: An accepted Android foreground-service start must be promoted before cancellation is delivered. Calling Context.stopService before the pending start callbacks run can crash the process with ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException even when onCreate subsequently promotes.
canonical_prevention: Queue cancellation as an ordinary service start command, promote before inspecting each delivered command, and stop using that command's startId so an older cancellation cannot terminate a newer queued start. Exercise the production service in hermetic lifecycle tests and an isolated Android 16 emulator probe.
